content.short: Quai Network is the only fully scalable and programmable Proof-of-Work Layer-1.
content.description: Quai Network is crypto for the global and compute economies. It introduces a family of new Proof-of-Work primitives, including a native stablecoin tied to energy costs that creates a new category of on-chain value. This energy-backed stablecoin functions as decentralized money for a compute-centered economy, and its scalable architecture is designed to accommodate an ever-growing user base of both humans and AI agents, enabling secure, programmable financial infrastructure for compute tasks.

resources.tldr: Solo mining has meant choosing between custody, identity checks and fees. What a non-custodial, zero-fee setup gives up to avoid that.
